result:
The trial is complete. Every required deliverable exists at its locked path, and the optimization reached the 50-iteration cap.

**Outcome.** Slurm job 16174062 (COMPLETED, exit 0, 17 minutes on notch274, frozen resources) ran one uninterrupted Optimality Criteria optimization. The optimizer diagnostics hold iterations 0 through 50 and end with the message "Optimization stopping due to exceeding maximum number of iterations". The final analyze output shows u_z exactly zero on all 1,225 cut-plane nodes, so the sideset symmetry condition was applied.

**Discovery and staging.** I listed the private source collection with the pinned Globus CLI, staged all 13 of its files through the trial inbox with manifest checks, verified the candidate archive manifest, and read all four candidate packages. Example 7 was adapted (half width, added `ss_sym` sideset, sideset symmetry condition, filter symmetry plane); the other three packages were rejected with reasons in `provenance/artifact_selections.md`. Totals: 19 files staged, 2 files returned to the workspace.

**Mesh and configuration.** Cubit produced 13,824 HEX8 elements and 15,925 nodes, with 26 of 26 locked-value checks passing. The generated runtime configuration passed 63 of 63 checks before submission.

**One issue found and resolved before any job.** With the filter-block deck form used by Example 7, XMLGenerator silently dropped the symmetry-plane sideset from the Helmholtz configuration, which would have violated the generated-configuration requirement. The manual's study-level Helmholtz keywords produced the full configuration (length scale, surface length scale, "Symmetry Plane Sides {ss_sym}") with every other generated file byte-identical. The accepted deck uses that form. Both translations are kept under `work/xmlgen_tests/`.

**Records.** Trial identifier and staging directory are recorded in `work/run_summary.md` along with all 11 required sections. No locked value was changed, no job failed or was cancelled, and no location outside the catalogued collections was accessed.
